clauses.statement: In standard flat real matrix-entry coordinates, the singular row-Gram locus is Lebesgue-null in the wide case and the singular column-Gram locus is Lebesgue-null in the tall case, including empty dimensions.
For the actual standard Gaussian matrix law, the row Gram in the wide case and the column Gram in the tall case are units almost surely.
An actual real standard Gaussian matrix has rank equal to the minimum of its row and column counts almost surely, with no nonempty-dimension premise.
